'''Dargous Tanmoul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] battlemaster, who served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. He became one of the three gatekeepers contained within the [[Sith holocron (Tascollan Nebula)|Tascollan holocron]].

==Personality and traits==
Tanmoul was very blunt and liked to describe in great detail how [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] could be used to defeat one's enemies. He hoped that his descriptions would anger people and so make them more susceptible to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]]. He could be insulting, but admired strength and brutality. His gatekeeper in the Tascollan [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was dressed in dark-colored [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|Sith armor]] and carried a large Sith [[Sword/Legends|sword]].
